_about: Replies a model really writes, and what the reader must see. `expected` is TYPED BY HAND from the product's figure standard (frontend/lib/money: the number format of the TEXT's language, the ISO code after the figure) - never produced by a normaliser - and carries plain spaces: a law compares through plain spaces (U+00A0 and U+202F read as a space). `kept`: every token deliberately left as written, in text order, with the reason the normaliser must report for it - nothing else may be reported. `allowed`: a currency standing before a number that the standard leaves there by rule (masked before the detector reads the text). `anchors`: figures the model was handed. `surface`: where such a reply appears (chat, briefing, both). `wrong`: expected differs from input. Invented figures only. Both runtimes are held to this file: frontend/lib/readerFigures.ts and src/engine/ai/figure_format.py.
